# FanGraphs Baseball

> > Advanced baseball analysis, sabermetrics, and data-driven insights covering MLB teams, players, projections, and the Hall of Fame.

FanGraphs Baseball is a premier source for baseball analytics, featuring ZiPS projections by Dan Szymborski, Hall of Fame analysis by Jay Jaffe, the Effectively Wild podcast, RosterResource depth charts, and FanGraphs Lab tools. The site combines statistical analysis with player development insights, contract evaluations, and team breakdowns.

## Key Topics

- ZiPS Projections
- Baseball Analytics
- FanGraphs Lab
- RosterResource
- Hall of Fame Analysis
- Contract Analysis
- Free Agency
- Team Projections
- Player Development
- Prospect Analysis
- Sabermetrics
- Effectively Wild Podcast
- MLB Depth Charts
- Advanced Statistics
- 2026 Season Previews

- [2026 ZiPS Projections: New York Mets](https://blogs.fangraphs.com/2026-zips-projections-new-york-mets): Dan Szymborski's ZiPS 2026 Mets projections with Pete Alonso roster
- [Effectively Wild Episode 2438: Season Preview Series: Pirates and Twins](https://blogs.fangraphs.com/effectively-wild-episode-2438-season-preview-series-pirates-and-twins): Lindbergh & Rowley preview 2026 Pirates and Twins seasons

## Hall of Fame & Baseball History

- [Peering Into the Crystal Ball: The Next Five Years of BBWAA Hall of Fame Elections](https://blogs.fangraphs.com/peering-into-the-crystal-ball-the-next-five-years-of-bbwaa-hall-of-fame-elections): Jay Jaffe analyzes next 5 years of BBWAA Hall of Fame elections post-2026
- [The Defense Rests: A Tribute to Bill Mazeroski (1936–2026)](https://blogs.fangraphs.com/the-defense-rests-a-tribute-to-bill-mazeroski-1936-2026): Jay Jaffe tribute to HOF second baseman Bill Mazeroski's legacy & 1960 WS
